title: City Parks Announces Pass Arboretum Accreditation
summary: Syracuse Parks Department achieved Level I accreditation for James Pass Arboretum through the ArbNet Accreditation Program, recognizing it as an internationally certified tree museum. The accreditation validates completion of Phase I improvements including new species plantings, tree labeling, outdoor classrooms, and accessibility upgrades. Phase II improvements are planned for Fall 2026 and may unlock additional funding for conservation and public education initiatives.
department_refs: Department of Parks, Recreation and Youth Programs

political_signal.description: Accreditation announcement demonstrates municipal commitment to environmental stewardship, public education, and community green space enhancement. Positions Parks Department as professionally managed and grant-eligible.
